controls.title: Authority hierarchy
controls.requirement: All contracts MUST preserve Books I-IV and X; conflict MUST fail closed and be recorded.

controls.title: Contract registration
controls.requirement: Every machine interaction admitted to a declared live-effect environment and approved Reality Boundary stage MUST use a registered versioned contract.

controls.title: No architectural redesign
controls.requirement: A contract MUST NOT move responsibility, state ownership, or authority between Book IV components.

controls.title: Common envelope
controls.requirement: Every message MUST carry message, contract, schema, correlation, causation, producer, time, provenance, classification, and integrity metadata.

controls.title: Freshness
controls.requirement: Receivers MUST enforce declared issued-at, expiry, and maximum-age constraints.

controls.title: Canonical identifiers
controls.requirement: Identifiers MUST be opaque, stable, globally unambiguous, and MUST NOT embed mutable Authority or Permission claims.

controls.title: Authenticated identity
controls.requirement: Every non-public interaction MUST authenticate sender and intended recipient.

controls.title: Authority context
controls.requirement: Protected interactions MUST carry integrity-protected authority, delegation, policy, purpose, and constraint references.

controls.title: No ambient authority
controls.requirement: Network location, credentials, data possession, or component execution MUST NOT independently confer authority.

controls.title: Decision freshness
controls.requirement: Authority decisions MUST be current for the proposed action and invalidated by revocation, expiry, or material proposal change.

controls.title: Denied means no effect
controls.requirement: A denial response MUST be terminal for the attempted action and MUST NOT be converted into success by a transport adapter.

controls.title: Idempotency key
controls.requirement: Every retriable command MUST require a caller-stable idempotency key scoped to principal, operation, and semantic payload.

controls.title: Duplicate disposition
controls.requirement: A duplicate command MUST return the recorded disposition and MUST NOT repeat the effect.

controls.title: Reality ambiguity
controls.requirement: An ambiguous Reality Boundary outcome MUST enter reconciliation; automatic replay is prohibited until real-world state is verified.

controls.title: Bounded retry
controls.requirement: Retry policy MUST declare attempts, elapsed-time budget, backoff, jitter, and retryable codes.

controls.title: Deadline propagation
controls.requirement: Callers MUST propagate a monotonic remaining deadline; intermediaries MUST NOT extend it.

controls.title: Cancellation
controls.requirement: Cancellation MUST be explicit and MUST NOT imply rollback of an already committed effect.

controls.title: Backpressure
controls.requirement: Streams and event consumers MUST apply bounded buffering, demand signaling, and overload disposition.

controls.title: Ordering scope
controls.requirement: Contracts MUST declare no ordering, per-key ordering, or total ordering; consumers MUST NOT infer stronger order.

controls.title: Event immutability
controls.requirement: Events MUST describe completed facts and MUST NOT be rewritten; correction uses a new linked event.

controls.title: Structured errors
controls.requirement: Errors MUST use the HAL error schema with stable code, category, retry disposition, correlation, and detail bounded by classification, privacy, and secret-disclosure controls.

controls.title: No sensitive errors
controls.requirement: Error messages MUST NOT expose secrets, sensitive payloads, internal credentials, or prohibited inference.

controls.title: Partial result
controls.requirement: Partial results MUST be explicitly marked with omitted scopes and MUST NOT be represented as complete.

controls.title: Semantic versioning
controls.requirement: Major versions indicate incompatible semantics; minor versions are backward-compatible additions; patches do not change semantics.

controls.title: Unknown schema
controls.requirement: Unknown or incompatible schemas MUST be rejected or handled by an explicitly approved compatibility adapter.

controls.title: Consumer tolerance
controls.requirement: Consumers MAY ignore declared extension fields but MUST reject unknown required semantics.

controls.title: Deprecation
controls.requirement: Deprecation MUST publish replacement, migration evidence, first notice, last supported version, and removal date.

controls.title: Resource limits
controls.requirement: Contracts MUST publish payload, batch, rate, concurrency, and stream limits with deterministic exceedance errors.

controls.title: Pagination
controls.requirement: List queries MUST use opaque, integrity-protected cursors bound to filter, sort, principal, and snapshot semantics.

controls.title: Filtering
controls.requirement: Filterable and sortable fields MUST be allowlisted; unrecognized fields MUST fail validation.

controls.title: Transport protection
controls.requirement: Confidentiality and integrity MUST protect every non-public hop with authenticated peer identity.

controls.title: Input validation
controls.requirement: Receivers MUST validate structure, type, bounds, encoding, canonicalization, classification, current Authority, and the exact Permission decision before use.

controls.title: Replay defense
controls.requirement: Protected requests MUST include nonce or idempotency identity, time bounds, and integrity evidence sufficient to detect replay.

controls.title: Data minimization
controls.requirement: Schemas MUST include only fields necessary for the declared purpose and authorized consumer.

controls.title: Field classification
controls.requirement: Sensitive fields MUST declare classification, purpose, retention, redaction, and logging rules.

controls.title: Disclosure check
controls.requirement: Disclosure MUST be checked against identity, authority, audience, Presence, purpose, privacy policy, and Treaty where applicable.

controls.title: Treaty required
controls.requirement: Cross-domain exchange MUST cite an active applicable Treaty and MUST fail closed if absent, expired, revoked, or materially drifted.

controls.title: Firewall admission
controls.requirement: Every external ingress and egress MUST pass the Constitutional Firewall; direct bypass is prohibited.

controls.title: Separate approvals
controls.requirement: Treaty approval MUST NOT substitute for capability-class or action authority approval.

controls.title: Trace correlation
controls.requirement: Interactions MUST emit correlation, causation, contract version, outcome, latency, and policy-decision references.

controls.title: Evidence integrity
controls.requirement: Audit evidence MUST be tamper-evident, access-controlled, retention-governed, and attributable.

controls.title: Sensitive telemetry
controls.requirement: Telemetry MUST use redaction or references rather than unrestricted sensitive payload copies.

controls.title: Stream resume
controls.requirement: Resumable streams MUST use opaque cursors with declared retention and gap behavior.

controls.title: Stream termination
controls.requirement: Streams MUST define normal completion, cancellation, deadline, Authority or Permission loss, Treaty loss, overload, and integrity-failure closure.

controls.title: Schema validation
controls.requirement: Every release MUST validate examples and artifacts against the registered schemas.

controls.title: Contract tests
controls.requirement: Providers and consumers MUST pass positive, denial, malformed, incompatible, replay, timeout, duplicate, and limit tests.

controls.title: Breaking-change gate
controls.requirement: Incompatible change MUST create a new major contract and coexist through the approved migration window.

controls.title: Evidence manifest
controls.requirement: Certification MUST bind tested artifacts, hashes, versions, environment, results, and approving roles.
